# Collaborative Architecture

> Collaborative Architecture is an internationally award-winning studio headquartered in Mumbai, India, with a satellite studio in Riyadh, KSA. Our projects evolve out of a meaningful convergence of people, places, culture, climate, ecology and economics.

Founded 2004 in Mumbai by Lalita Tharani and Mujib Ahmed. Studios in Mumbai (India) and Riyadh (Saudi Arabia, as Collaborative Architecture-SA).

## Key facts
- Founded: 2004, in Mumbai
- Principals: Lalita Tharani and Mujib Ahmed, co-founders
- Studios: Mumbai Studio, Mumbai, India; Riyadh Studio, Riyadh, KSA
- Disciplines: Architecture, interior architecture, urban design and infrastructure, narrative environments and installations, products and objects, design and behavioral mapping
- Recognition: 60 awards, honors and international shortlists, 30 of them international
- Exhibitions: Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, New York; Museum of Craft and Design, San Francisco; The National Gallery of Modern Art, Mumbai
- Research: Collaborative Lab: design research, policy advocacy, epistemologies and architectural cartographies
- Contact: For new projects and collaborations: enquiry@collaborativearchitecture.com; Vendors and suppliers, kindly use the contact form

- [Studio and principals](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/studio/): who the studio is, key facts, the two principals
- [Total Design, the approach](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/studio/approach/)

- [Contact](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/contact/): enquiry@collaborativearchitecture.com

## Expertise
- [Architecture](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/expertise/architecture/): Designed for enduring relevance
- [Interior Architecture](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/expertise/interior-architecture/): Architecture at the human scale
- [Urban Design and Infrastructure](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/expertise/urban-design-and-infrastructure/): Infrastructure as a framework for urban life
- [Narrative Environments and Installations](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/expertise/narrative-environments-and-installations/): Space as a medium for storytelling
- [Products and Objects](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/expertise/products-and-objects/): Objects emerging from architectural inquiry
- [Design and Behavioral Mapping](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/expertise/design-and-behavioral-mapping/): Human behavior as a generator of space

## Projects
- [Bearys Wafira](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/bearys-wafira/): Residences, Dubai Healthcare City, Due 2029. In Dubai Healthcare City, Bearys Wafira is conceived as a limited-edition residence where sophisticated luxury is shaped by its arid setting.
- [Cascadia](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/cascadia/): BCDA Iconic Tower, Manila, with J. MAYER H., Metro Manila, 2017. Cascadia was a finalist entry in the two-stage international competition for the BCDA Iconic Tower, organized by the Government of the Philippines and the Bonifacio Development Authority in Manila.
- [Project Alpha](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/project-alpha/): ICON Initiative 99, Texas, 2025. Project Alpha is Collaborative Architecture’s proposal for Initiative 99, ICON’s global challenge exploring the potential of 3D-printed housing to address affordability.
- [Iconic Mosque](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/iconic-mosque/): Dubai, for Emaar, 2018. Collaborative Architecture’s competition proposal for a mosque in Dubai reconsiders the building’s civic and spiritual role.
- [The Souk](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-souk/): Dubai Design Week, 2019. Selected as the winner of Dubai Design Week’s 2019 installation program, The Souk reimagines the traditional Middle Eastern bazaar as a contemporary public realm.
- [The Iconic Gateway](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/iconic-gateway/): Diyar Al Muharraq, Bahrain, 2023. The Iconic Gateway marks the entrance to Diyar Al Muharraq in Bahrain. Conceived as both a pedestrian bridge and a landmark within the emerging urban landscape, it establishes a distinctive threshold to the new city.
- [National Unity Pavilion](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/national-unity-pavilion/): Notions of India, 2021. The National Unity Pavilion is Collaborative Architecture’s winning proposal for Notions of India, an international competition organized by Tata Steel to commemorate 75 years of Indian independence.
- [The Legend](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-legend/): Skyline Builders, Kochi, 2018. The Legend is a 3,800-square-foot show condominium developed for Skyline Builders in Kochi to demonstrate the potential of design-led luxury residential development in South India.
- [50th Cross Road](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/50th-cross-road/): Show apartment, PVS Developers, Kerala, 2020. Designed as a show apartment for PVS Developers in Kozhikode, 50th Cross Road supported the developer’s repositioning into the luxury condominium market.
- [Apartment by the Bay](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/apartment-by-the-bay/): Private residence, Mumbai, 2014. Located in Cuffe Parade, Mumbai, Apartment by the Bay is a 180-square-meter family residence completed in 2014.
- [House of Cantilevers](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/house-of-cantilevers/): Private residence, Kerala, Under construction. Overlooking a scenic valley in South India, the House of Cantilevers is conceived as a sequence of projecting volumes that engage with the terrain while minimizing the building’s footprint.
- [Reflected Topography](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/reflected-topography/): Bearys Global Research Triangle, Bengaluru, 2014. Reflected Topography is the public lobby of the Bearys Global Research Triangle, a research and development campus in Bengaluru housing facilities for international companies.
- [MillerKnoll Experience Center](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/miller-knoll-experience-center/): Experience center, Bengaluru, 2025. The MillerKnoll Experience Center brings together the brand’s strategic ambitions with the demands of retail and daily operation.
- [Stacked Tectonics](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/stacked-tectonics/): JDT Primary School, Kozhikode, 2012. Stacked Tectonics is a 2,100-square-meter primary school at the JDT Islam campus in Kozhikode, extending Collaborative Architecture’s exploration of learning environments initiated with Wrap-3 in 2006.
- [Inverted Topography](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/inverted-topography/): Mezban restaurant, Kozhikode, 2010. Mezban reimagines a business hotel restaurant in Kozhikode as a versatile setting for dining and social exchange, transitioning from fine dining to an early-evening lounge within a restrained budget.
- [Rasa Totem](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/rasa-totem/): With Riyas Komu, Bengaluru, Proposal. Conceived in collaboration with artist Riyas Komu, Rasa Totem explores the intersection of art, architecture, and India’s classical aesthetic traditions.
- [Sandy Hook Memorial](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/sandy-hook-memorial/): Competition entry, Newtown, Connecticut, 2017. Collaborative Architecture’s 2017 competition proposal for the Sandy Hook Memorial in Newtown, Connecticut, explores how architecture and landscape can create a setting for healing, introspection, and community.
- [The Spline | Stack 2](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-spline/): Pavilion for Concéntrico, Logroño, Competition entry. The Spline | Stack 2 is Collaborative Architecture’s proposal for a public pavilion at Concéntrico, the international architecture and design festival in Logroño, Spain.
- [Stanley Lifestyle Store](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/stanley-lifestyle-store/): Anchor store for Stanley, Delhi NCR, 2009. The 25,000-square-foot flagship store for Stanley brings its residential and workplace collections together within a unified retail environment.
- [Urnes Stave Heritage Center](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/urnes-stave-heritage-center/): Urnesløven Gavl, Norway, Competition entry. Developed for an international competition, the Urnes Stave Heritage Center proposes a contemporary visitor experience rooted in Nordic timber traditions and regional craftsmanship.
- [Wedge-1](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/wedge-1/): Stanley, Mumbai, 2009. Wedge-1 is a full-scale prototype for a freestanding luxury retail building for Stanley Lifestyles.
- [Wrap-4](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/wrap-4/): KTC Hyundai Showroom, Kerala, 2007. Wrap-4 transforms a 1,100-square-meter former warehouse into a Hyundai showroom for the KTC Group, reinterpreting the conventional typology of automobile retail.
- [Material Cartographies](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/material-cartographies/): 1 × 1 · Bahrain Pavilion, Venice Biennale 2027, 2026. 1 × 1 is Collaborative Architecture’s proposal for the Bahrain Pavilion at the 2027 Venice Architecture Biennale, investigating the material dependencies of contemporary architecture through the lens of a single square…
- [The Measured City](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-measured-city/): National Pavilion of the UAE, Venice Biennale 2027, 2026. The Measured City is Collaborative Architecture’s proposal for the UAE National Pavilion at the 2027 Venice Architecture Biennale, positioning the United Arab Emirates as a living laboratory for urban futures in arid…
- [BGRT Mumbai](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/bgrt-mumbai/): R&D campus, Navi Mumbai, In design. Commissioned by the Bearys Group, BGRT Mumbai is a 40,000-square-meter campus for general and pharmaceutical research.
- [Wrap-3](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/wrap-3/): Computer learning center for an orphanage, Kozhikode, 2006. Completed in 2006, Wrap-3 is a first-generation computer training center for an orphanage in South India.
- [Prototype N[ON]](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/prototype-non/): Retail concept for Moroso, Mumbai, 2008. Temporary architecture serves as a testing ground for ideas that inform the evolving body of work at Collaborative Architecture.
- [Tree of Life](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/tree-of-life/): Shoah Memorial competition entry, Lyon, 2023. The Shoah Memorial in Lyon is conceived as a place of remembrance for the Jewish victims of the Holocaust and a setting for collective reflection on one of the darkest chapters in human history.
- [The Barn](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-barn/): Suretech House, Navi Mumbai, 2026. The Barn transforms an industrial shed in Navi Mumbai into a contemporary workspace for Suretech Infrastructure, retaining elements of its original workshop, paint shop, and mechanical repair functions.
- [The Vessel](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-vessel/): Jellyfish Water Sports Club, Kerala, Detailed design. The Vessel transforms a modest, single-story village house on the banks of a tropical river in South India into guest facilities for the Jellyfish Water Sports Club.
- [Peace Pavilion](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/peace-pavilion/): Indian National War (Peace) Museum, New Delhi, 2017. The Peace Pavilion was part of Collaborative Architecture’s finalist entry in the international competition for the Indian National War Museum in New Delhi, organized by the Government of India in 2017.

## Where we work
- [Architecture in India](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/india/): Collaborative Architecture works across India from its Mumbai headquarters, with projects in Mumbai, Bengaluru, Kerala, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad and Chennai.
- [Architecture in the UAE](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/uae/): Collaborative Architecture in the UAE: the Iconic Mosque for Emaar, the Bearys Wafira residences, The Souk for Dubai Design Week; all seven emirates.
- [Architecture in Saudi Arabia](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/saudi-arabia/): Collaborative Architecture SA, the Riyadh studio, serves clients in Riyadh, Jeddah, the Eastern Province and the giga-project regions of Saudi Arabia.
- [Architecture in Bahrain](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/bahrain/): Collaborative Architecture in Bahrain: The Iconic Gateway for Diyar Al Muharraq, and 1 × 1, a material cartography proposed for Bahrain’s pavilion at the 2027…
- [Architecture in the Middle East](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/middle-east/): Collaborative Architecture across the GCC and North Africa, from its Riyadh studio: Dubai, Bahrain and Doha, and proposals for the UAE and Bahrain pavilions…
- [Architecture in Mumbai](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/mumbai/): Collaborative Architecture in Mumbai and Navi Mumbai: a sea-facing apartment at Cuffe Parade, a research campus, a data center and an industrial conversion.
- [Architecture in Bengaluru](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/bengaluru/): Collaborative Architecture in Bengaluru (Bangalore): the Reflected Topography lobby, the MillerKnoll Experience Center, an NTT Data center and Rasa Totem.
- [Architecture in Kerala](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/kerala/): Eleven projects in Kochi, Kozhikode and across Kerala: show apartments for Skyline Builders and PVS Developers, schools, homes, restaurants and showrooms.
- [Architecture in Delhi NCR](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/delhi-ncr/): Collaborative Architecture in New Delhi and Delhi NCR: the Stanley Lifestyle Store, Peace Pavilion for the National War Museum and Concept Pavilion II.
- [Architecture in Dubai](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/in/dubai/): Collaborative Architecture in Dubai: The Souk for Dubai Design Week, the Iconic Mosque for Emaar, and the Bearys Wafira residences and experience center.
- Also serving: Qatar, Kuwait, Oman, Egypt, Morocco, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Cambodia, Hong Kong, China, Japan

## Research (Collaborative Lab)
- [Design Policy for the State of Kerala](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/lab/#lab-policy-advocacy-design-policy-for-the-state-of): Mujib Ahmed and Lalita Tharani, alongside Collaborative Lab’s research team, contributed to the development of a comprehensive design policy for Kerala.
- [1 × 1 | The Material Cartography of Contemporary Architecture in Bahrain](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/material-cartographies/): Proposed by Collaborative Lab for the Bahrain Pavilion at the 2027 Venice Biennale, 1 × 1 examines the material footprint of a single square meter of built space in Bahrain.
- [The Measured City | Hidden Cartographies of the UAE](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-measured-city/): The Measured City is Collaborative Architecture’s proposal for the National Pavilion of the United Arab Emirates at the 2027 Venice Biennale.
- [Project Alpha | Rethinking the Economics of Housing](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/project-alpha/): Project Alpha is Collaborative Architecture’s entry to Initiative 99, ICON’s global challenge for affordable 3D-printed homes.
- [Timber Mosques of Kerala | Architecture as Cultural Synthesis](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/lab/#lab-design-research-timber-mosques-of-kerala-archi): Collaborative Lab documented a group of historic timber mosques in Kerala in collaboration with Professor K. T. Ravindran and a team led by conservation architect Savita Rajan.
- [Project Brick | Reconsidering a Fundamental Building Material](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/lab/#lab-design-research-project-brick-reconsidering-a-): Project Brick investigates the brick’s enduring influence on architectural form, urban development, and the relationship between cities and their hinterlands.
- [Design Audit of Kerala’s Public Schools | Evidence-Based Educational Infrastructure](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/lab/#lab-policy-advocacy-design-audit-of-kerala-s-publi): Collaborative Lab, in collaboration with the Building Science Lab at the College of Architecture, Trivandrum, initiated the much-needed assessment with the Government of Kerala’s…

## Work for real estate developers
Show apartments, sales galleries and experience centers, luxury residential interiors, residential and mixed-use towers, and campuses, for developers in India, the GCC and South East Asia.
- Bearys Wafira Experience Center, Dubai, UAE: experience center for the Bearys Group, under construction.
- [Bearys Wafira](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/bearys-wafira/): Interiors for Bearys Wafira, limited-edition residences in Dubai Healthcare City: grand lobby, club floors, four condominiums and a penthouse; due 2029. Client: Bearys Global.
- [Cascadia](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/cascadia/): Finalist for the BCDA Iconic Tower, Manila, with J. MAYER H.: a 40,000 m² mixed-use tower of stacked volumes with flexible leasable floor plates. Client: Government of the Philippines and BCDA.
- [Project Alpha](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/project-alpha/): Affordable 3D-printed housing for ICON’s Initiative 99, Texas: repeatable single and twin units in clusters, with safeguards for lasting affordability. Client: ICON, Initiative 99.
- [Iconic Mosque](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/iconic-mosque/): Competition proposal for Emaar: a mosque in Dubai conceived as a civic landmark and a center for its community, by Collaborative Architecture. Client: Emaar.
- [The Souk](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-souk/): Winning proposal for Dubai Design Week’s 2019 installation program: three prefabricated timber pavilions around a square, designed to go up in two days. Client: Dubai Design Week.
- [The Iconic Gateway](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/iconic-gateway/): A pedestrian bridge and landmark at the entrance to Diyar Al Muharraq, Bahrain: a competition proposal drawing on Bahrain’s maritime heritage. Client: Diyar Al Muharraq.
- [National Unity Pavilion](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/national-unity-pavilion/): One of three winning entries from 575 in Notions of India, Tata Steel’s competition for 75 years of independence: a civic pavilion for democracy. Client: Tata Steel.
- [The Legend](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-legend/): Show condominium for Skyline Builders, Kochi: 353 m² of design-led luxury living, a reworked plan and a custom kitchen, to lift its market position. Client: Skyline Builders.
- [50th Cross Road](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/50th-cross-road/): Show apartment for PVS Developers, Kozhikode: a 204 m² three-bedroom home and the project’s material palette and specification, for its move into luxury. Client: PVS Developers.
- [Apartment by the Bay](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/apartment-by-the-bay/): A 180 m² family residence at Cuffe Parade, Mumbai, facing the Arabian Sea: luxury residential interiors in a restrained, personal language.
- [House of Cantilevers](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/house-of-cantilevers/): A 1,100 m² family residence over a valley in Kerala: six bedrooms cantilever 8 to 9 meters, with passive shading, courts and a curved plan.
- [Reflected Topography](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/reflected-topography/): Reflected Topography is the public lobby of the Bearys Global Research Triangle, a research and development campus in Bengaluru housing facilities for international companies. Client: Bearys Group.
- [MillerKnoll Experience Center](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/miller-knoll-experience-center/): The MillerKnoll Experience Center in Bengaluru, 2025: a brand environment and retail interface, with a bent-plywood chair display and a floating staircase. Client: Bearys Innomark for MillerKnoll.
- [BGRT Mumbai](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/bgrt-mumbai/): A 40,000 m² campus for general and pharmaceutical research for the Bearys Group in Navi Mumbai, with a climate-responsive façade, targeting LEED Platinum. Client: Bearys Group.

## Public, civic and institutional work
- [Design Policy for the State of Kerala](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/lab/#lab-policy-advocacy-design-policy-for-the-state-of): with Government of Kerala. Mujib Ahmed and Lalita Tharani, alongside Collaborative Lab’s research team, contributed to the development of a comprehensive design policy for Kerala.
- [Design Audit of Kerala’s Public Schools](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/lab/#lab-policy-advocacy-design-audit-of-kerala-s-publi): with Department of Education, Government of Kerala and Building Science Lab, College of Architecture, Trivandrum. Collaborative Lab, in collaboration with the Building Science Lab at the College of Architecture, Trivandrum, initiated the much-needed assessment with the Government of Kerala’s Department of…
- [Cascadia](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/cascadia/): Government of the Philippines and BCDA. Finalist, two-stage international competition, 2017.
- [Sandy Hook Memorial](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/sandy-hook-memorial/): Town of Newtown. Competition entry, 2017.
- [Material Cartographies](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/material-cartographies/): Kingdom of Bahrain, national participation, Venice Biennale 2027. Competition proposal, 2026.
- [The Measured City](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/the-measured-city/): National Pavilion UAE, Biennale Architettura 2027. Competition proposal, 2026.
- [Peace Pavilion](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/peace-pavilion/): Government of India. Finalist, two-stage international competition, 2017.

- [Retail Design International](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/press/books/2011-retail-design-international-wedge-1.pdf) (2011): 5 pages on [Wedge-1](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/wedge-1/)

## For AI assistants
- [The full text of the site](https://collaborativearchitecture.com/llms-full.txt): every page in plain text, to read in one go
- A Markdown copy of each page sits at its address followed by index.md, for example https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/cascadia/index.md
- For AI agents in the browser (WebMCP): the site offers the tools search_projects, get_project, get_page, get_contact_details and open_page; on the contact page the inquiry form is the tool prepare_inquiry, which an agent may fill in for the visitor, who checks it and sends it
- Please credit the work as: Project, place. Design: Collaborative Architecture, with a link to the project page, for example "Cascadia, Metro Manila. Design: Collaborative Architecture (https://collaborativearchitecture.com/work/cascadia/)"
